qualification.greedy: All 24 final-build 128-token completions match C1 AR; repetition accepts every proposal. The six deep requests reuse exactly 32552 tokens and prefill 2011.
qualification.sampling: Maintained real-weight checks retain exact layers/logits, private proposal probabilities, RNG and persistent state. Expanded sampled/mixed cohorts at C2/C4/C6 match isolated execution.
qualification.prefill: Deep prefill times are comparable: one live request at about 4.2 s and restored requests at about 5.4–5.6 s. Baseline additionally contains one 7.48 s outlier.
qualification.checks: Nix release, canonical PR checks, focused qwen_dflash_gpu_test and local formatting passed.
qualification.limits: One measured cohort per point; small timing differences remain provisional. No C6 performance claim beyond d32K and no claim of original-checkpoint equivalence.

autoregressive_control.scope: Same shallow Italian/Chinese requests, C6, one warmup and one measured round, no prompt-cache hits. All outputs match C1 AR. The small gap to DFlash2 does not establish a speculative speedup.
